summary:
Full-arc session on Cerebro OAuth login UX — the castle and the 3-line answer.

**Started** with PR #68: a server-side OAuth resolver and banner system for /login, aimed at making Claude → Cerebro OAuth feel legit instead of phishing-adjacent. 5 rounds of commits, 236 mocked unit tests, visual QA via dev-preview with synthetic context. Shipped to develop, then to main. Banner never rendered on prod.

**Caught** after merging: the admin endpoint `/auth/v1/admin/oauth/authorizations/{id}` does not exist on Supabase. All 236 tests passed because they mocked fetch. Daniel walked me Socratically through the question "there's only one place that would possibly send someone — why can't referral be there for us?" until the answer fell out: the URL already carries the signal. No resolver needed. The specific app branding already rendered fine on /oauth/consent post-auth.

**Fixed** via PR #74 (develop) → PR #76 (main). 2,007 lines deleted, 88 added. Real Claude.ai → cerebro-mcp connector OAuth flow verified end-to-end by Daniel himself — login hint rendered, MFA clean, consent page showed specific app branding, Allow click returned valid code + state to example.com callback.

**Kept real wins caught while writing adversarial tests** (all security bugs unrelated to the broken main feature):
- safe-next-path consolidated across 3 duplicates + new defenses (URL-encoded backslash, CRLF injection, control chars)
- Shared url.ts helpers (isValidAuthorizationId + sanitiseHttpUrl)
- Consent actions hardening (shape check + redirect scheme validation)
- RBAC pathToPage prototype leak fix
- Consent helpers (parseScopes dedup+cap, redactUrl safety)
- 149 durable tests retained

**Documentation**:
- greenmark-cockpit ADR-2026-04 — "on pre-auth pages, use URL signal not server-side resolver"
- greenmark-cockpit reference/oauth-ux-test-tool.md — persistent DCR test client + PKCE authorize-URL generator for future smoke checks
- 3 memory entries saved: feedback_minimum_signal, feedback_mocked_is_not_verified, feedback_ui_browser_drive_before_done

**Key lesson — the anti-pattern**: I built confidence from evidence downstream of the failure mode. Types compiled, tests were green, CI passed, preview rendered. None of those reached through to "does this actually work against real Supabase." One curl on day one would have killed the castle in 30 seconds. Also: dev-preview with synthetic context does NOT count as browser verification — it's a mock with fancier rendering.
next_actions: Merge outstanding dependabot PRs on cerebro (#22 eslint, #23 vitest, #24 shadcn, #25 @types/node, #26 tailwind-merge) — routine upkeep
Merge cerebro-migrations PR #27 (settings.yml adoption) — completes governance-as-code wave

If OAuth UX ever wants the specific-client banner on /login: open a research.md finding on SECURITY DEFINER RPC pattern to expose authz-by-id pre-auth. Not needed for current UX (consent page already does this).

Consider adding a one-shot integration test in cerebro that hits Supabase admin endpoints with real service-role to catch future pattern-match API hallucinations. Low priority — the memory + ADR should deter recurrence.
Follow through on broader M-04 (Sage Medallion) milestone work; OAuth UX was a tangent from that.
